title: Browser and email demo (synthetic fixture)
summary: Demo only. Confirm the official app origin, let a human sign in and verify an email, then read the account status from a synthetic observation. No live claim is verified.

steps.title: Confirm the page is the official app
Sign in and verify the email in your own browser

checkpoints.action: Open only the official app in your own browser and log in yourself. Never paste a password or a one-time code into chat.
checkpoints.resume_when: You are signed in on the official app page and its address bar shows the official domain.

checkpoints.action: Gather the non-sensitive details this task asks for and supply them together. Leave out passwords, codes, and recovery phrases.
checkpoints.resume_when: Every required non-sensitive input is ready and nothing sensitive was shared in chat.

checkpoints.action: Complete the email verification step in your own mailbox. Read the code there and type it only into the official app. Never share a one-time code in chat.
checkpoints.resume_when: The official app shows the account as verified.
